question: ‘Letters from a Father to his Daughter’ was authored by whom among the following freedom fighters?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** authored the book **'Letters from a Father to his Daughter'**.
 
• This book is a collection of letters written by Nehru to his daughter, Indira Gandhi, in 1928.
